recent_articles.title: Rubio to visit India for bilateral talks; Quad Foreign Ministers’ meeting May-end - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **U.S.** Secretary of State **Marco Rubio** is set to visit India from May 24 to 26, his first since taking office last January. recent_articles.title: Bihar Cabinet expansion on May 7, Modi, Shah and Nabin to attend event - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin** will be present for the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet** in Patna on Thursday, May 7, 2026. recent_articles.title: Anantapur police bust international cricket betting racket run from Philippines; 10 arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anantapur police** in India have arrested 10 individuals involved in an international cricket betting racket operating from the Philippines. The operation, led by **Superintendent of Police P Jagadeesh**, saw the seizure of ₹19.70 lakh in cash and ₹18.20 lakh in bank accounts across nine banks.  The gang, which has members across the country, used digital payment platforms to facilitate illegal betting activities through an app offering cricket betting and other banned games. The operation was initiated after police received information about the group's activities during the ongoing IPL matches. **Shiva**, a Philippines-based member of the gang, recruited local associates to collect bank accounts, SIM cards, and passbooks before sending them to the Philippines via cargo pants.
